3. TWO SEPARATE SYSTEMS
My Guardian Link consists of two separate but connected systems:

The Mobile Application. The Licensed Application provides digital communication, account, location-sharing, messaging, incident-creation, and safety tools operated through the user’s device and My Guardian Link’s technology platform.

The Live Response Service. The Live Response Service is a human-operated service performed outside the Licensed Application through an External Response Center. Trained human Urgent Response Coordinators receive eligible assignments and may contact users, Trusted Contacts, or appropriate third parties.

The Licensed Application is the digital tool used to create and transmit information. The Live Response Service is the separate real-world human service that may act upon an eligible incident assignment.
4. WHAT THE MOBILE APPLICATION DOES
Subject to device compatibility, permissions, account status, feature availability, and applicable law, the Licensed Application may allow users to:
Create and manage a My Guardian Link account.
Complete and update a personal profile.
Add and manage Trusted Contacts and emergency information.
Create alerts or incident requests.
Enter, transmit, and receive incident-related messages.
Share device-reported location information and map links.
Receive notifications and communications.
View user-accessible incident or alert history.
Use approved training, demonstration, or practice features.

These are digital application tools. The Licensed Application does not itself provide human incident management, independently dispatch emergency responders, or guarantee that any person or public-safety agency will act upon an alert.
5. FREE USERS AND MEMBERS
A “Free User” is a user who has access to the digital application tools made available under the My Guardian Link Free Plan but is not currently eligible for the Live Response Service.

A “Member” is a user who is eligible for the Live Response Service through a paid individual or group membership, a sponsor-funded arrangement, an employer or organization program, or another authorized membership arrangement.

Free Users and Members may use the digital application tools made available for their accounts. Membership status determines whether an eligible incident may be assigned by the My Guardian Link backend to the External Response Center for human management. Membership does not purchase premium digital application functionality.
6. WHAT THE LIVE RESPONSE SERVICE DOES
For eligible Members and eligible incidents, the Live Response Service may include trained human personnel who:
Receive an eligible Live Response assignment from the My Guardian Link backend.
Review available incident, account, location, message, and contact information.
Attempt to contact the user.
Attempt to contact one or more Trusted Contacts.
Coordinate communications among the user, Trusted Contacts, and appropriate resources.

Contact 911, a public-safety answering point, law enforcement, fire services, emergency medical services, roadside assistance, or another appropriate resource when the coordinator determines that doing so is appropriate and reasonably possible.
Document coordinator actions and incident information.
The Live Response Service is performed by human operators outside the Licensed Application. It is not generated, delivered, or completed solely by the Licensed Application.
7. BACKEND WORKFLOW AND SERVICE ELIGIBILITY
The Licensed Application does not independently decide whether the Live Response Service will be provided. The general workflow is:
The user creates an alert or incident request through the Licensed Application.
The request and available information are transmitted to the My Guardian Link backend.
The backend evaluates available account information, membership eligibility, incident type, service configuration, and operational availability.
If the incident and user are eligible, the backend creates a Live Response assignment.
The assignment is transmitted to the External Response Center outside the Licensed Application.
A trained human Urgent Response Coordinator receives and manages the assignment according to available information, procedures, professional judgment, and operational conditions.

Eligibility, assignment creation, coordinator availability, and the actions taken during an incident are controlled by backend and human-service processes, not by unlocking additional digital functionality within the Licensed Application.
8. WHAT A CUSTOMER PURCHASES

A My Guardian Link membership purchases eligibility for access to the Live Response Service, including trained human Urgent Response Coordinators, human incident review, communication coordination, appropriate outreach, response-center operations, and incident documentation.

A membership does not purchase additional premium digital features in the Licensed Application. The app license and digital application tools are separate from the human-operated Live Response Service.

A membership does not guarantee that every alert will qualify for a Live Response assignment, that a coordinator will be immediately available, that any particular action will be taken, or that an emergency agency or other third party will respond.
9. URGENT RESPONSE COORDINATORS AND EXTERNAL RESPONSE CENTER
An “Urgent Response Coordinator” is a trained human operator who works through an External Response Center outside the Licensed Application.

The “External Response Center” is a response operation maintained by one or more third-party service providers under agreement with Forward Move. Urgent Response Coordinators and External Response Center personnel may be employees or independent contractors of those third-party service providers and are not Apple employees.

Urgent Response Coordinators may rely on information provided by you, your device, My Guardian Link systems, Trusted Contacts, and third parties. They may exercise judgment based on the information and resources available at the time. They do not control public-safety agencies or guarantee dispatch, response, rescue, intervention, or any particular outcome.
10. IMPORTANT EMERGENCY-RESPONSE LIMITATIONS MY GUARDIAN LINK IS NOT 911 AND DOES NOT REPLACE CALLING 911 OR LOCAL EMERGENCY SERVICES.

If you can safely call 911 or another appropriate emergency number directly, you should do so. You must not rely on the Licensed Application or the Live Response Service as your only method of obtaining emergency assistance.
Activating an alert or incident feature does not guarantee that:
The alert or information will be transmitted, received, reviewed, or acted upon.
A Trusted Contact will receive, view, answer, or respond to a communication.
A Live Response assignment will be created.
An Urgent Response Coordinator will be immediately available or able to reach you.
A public-safety agency or other resource will be contacted or will accept the information provided.
Police, fire, emergency medical personnel, roadside providers, or other responders will be dispatched or will arrive within any particular time.
Your device location will be available, current, complete, or accurate.
A coordinator or third party will correctly identify your identity, condition, circumstances, or location.

My Guardian Link does not independently dispatch law enforcement, fire services, emergency medical services, or other emergency responders. Any response decision is made by the applicable public-safety agency or third-party provider.
11. LOCATION INFORMATION

With your permission, the Licensed Application may collect and transmit location information reported by your device, including latitude and longitude, a map location or moving map pin, a nearby or estimated street address, a timestamp, and location updates available during an active incident.

Location information may be shared with Trusted Contacts, authorized Forward Move personnel, the External Response Center, Urgent Response Coordinators, contracted service providers, or public-safety agencies when reasonably necessary to provide the requested functionality or service.

Device-reported location may be delayed, unavailable, incomplete, or inaccurate because of indoor use, building construction, terrain, weather, GPS limitations, operating-system restrictions, disabled permissions, poor cellular or internet coverage, battery condition, device settings, network outages, third-party failures, or other circumstances outside Forward Move’s control.
You remain responsible for providing your address, surroundings, direction of travel, landmarks, or other location information whenever you are able.
12. SERVICE DEPENDENCIES
The Licensed Application and Live Response Service depend on systems, networks, people, and services that may be outside Forward Move’s control, including:

Cellular, Wi-Fi, internet, telephone, SMS, push-notification, and messaging networks.
GPS, device-location, cloud-hosting, and mapping providers.
Trusted Contacts and other recipients.
The My Guardian Link backend, External Response Center, and available personnel.
Public-safety answering points, 911 centers, government agencies, roadside providers, and other third parties.

Maintenance, service interruptions, transmission delays, technical failures, account configuration, unavailable personnel, public-safety workload, or third-party outages may prevent, delay, or impair operation.
13. USER RESPONSIBILITIES
You agree to:
Provide accurate account, identity, telephone, emergency, contact, and location information.
Keep your profile, membership, Trusted Contacts, and emergency information current.
Maintain a charged, compatible, and operational device and necessary cellular or internet service.
Enable permissions reasonably necessary for the features you choose to use.
Select appropriate and willing Trusted Contacts and obtain any consent required to provide their information.
Protect your login credentials and notify My Guardian Link promptly of suspected unauthorized access.
Use approved practice or demonstration features when testing the Licensed Application.
Avoid false, misleading, abusive, malicious, unauthorized, or fraudulent alerts or incident reports.
Call 911 or local emergency services directly when immediate assistance is required and you are safely able to do so.
14. PRIVACY AND INFORMATION SHARING

Your use of the Licensed Application is subject to the My Guardian Link Privacy Policy. Depending on the features you use, My Guardian Link may process account information, contact information, device information, location information, messages, alerts, incident records, coordinator notes, and optional personal, medical, caregiver, disability, or emergency information.

You authorize Forward Move and its service providers to collect, process, transmit, disclose, and retain information as reasonably necessary to provide the Licensed Application, digital application tools, Live Response Service, Trusted Contact communications, incident documentation, security, fraud prevention, legal compliance, and customer support.

Do not submit information that you do not want disclosed to Trusted Contacts, the External Response Center, Urgent Response Coordinators, public-safety resources, or other authorized recipients when reasonably necessary to provide the requested service.
15. NO GUARANTEE OF PREVENTION, PROTECTION, OR OUTCOME

My Guardian Link does not guarantee that the Licensed Application or Live Response Service will prevent a crime, injury, medical event, accident, property loss, disappearance, emergency, or other harmful occurrence.

My Guardian Link does not provide physical security, law-enforcement services, fire services, emergency medical treatment, medical diagnosis, legal advice, or insurance. The Licensed Application and Live Response Service are supplemental communication and coordination resources only.
